goal: Capture the enemy flag, win team skirmishes, or outlast up to 11 rivals in Free For All.
inviteSteps: Click Create Room on Tank Arena and pick Private or Open visibility.
Share the 4-letter Room Code, direct link, WhatsApp invite, or QR code from the Lobby.
Up to 12 friends join from PC, phone, or tablet—plus bots can fill any empty seat.

steps.title: One-Hand Space + One-Hand Mouse (Default)
steps.body: Your tank rotates automatically. Hold Spacebar with one hand to drive forward where it faces, and Left Click with your mouse to fire and reverse spin direction.

steps.title: Default Missile Fire & 5-Ammo Rack
steps.body: Your tank fires sharp standard missiles using a 5-shot rack (1.5s reload each). Save your shots to catch opponents cleanly!

steps.title: 3 Power Boxes: Shield, Speed 2× & Fireball
steps.body: 🛡️ Shield wraps a protective bubble around your tank that blocks opponent attacks (6s). ⚡ Speed 2× doubles your tank speed (6s). 🔥 Fireball grants Unlimited Rapid Fireball shots (7s)!

steps.title: Score to Win
steps.body: In Flag mode, touch the enemy flag and carry it back to your team pad. In Team Fight & FFA, score points by destroying enemy tanks.

tips: In Arcade (Space + Click), release Spacebar to let your tank auto-rotate, hold Spacebar to charge straight ahead, and Left Click to shoot & reverse spin!
Bricks break on the second hit, while yellow-black steel barriers never break.
Dropped flags auto-return in 10 seconds, or instantly if a teammate drives over them.
Spawn shields last 1.5 seconds and drop immediately as soon as you fire.
Press Tab on PC (or the scoreboard button on touch) anytime to check match stats.
